$ qm "new" "Spelled" "--project=demo" "--branch=feat/x" "--description=From equals"
exit 0
--- stdout
spelled
--- spelled.md
---
v: 1
title: Spelled
state: in_progress
project: demo
created: 'DATE'
branches:
- feat/x
---
